page_title: MNU 3-2 NOT | Manchester Utd v Nottingham Forest 26/08/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+13' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+12' A cross from the free kick is whipped in by Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham), but one of the defenders steps in and averts the threat.

90+12' Scott McTominay (Manchester United) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Stuart Attwell blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion. Nottingham will take a free kick.
90+10' Scott McTominay (Manchester United) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
90+8' Scott McTominay (Manchester United) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
90+6' Cheikhou Kouyate (Nottingham) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
90+6' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
90+3' An attempted cross from Victor Lindelof (Manchester United) is cleared.
90' There will be a minimum of 11 min. of added time.
89' Andre Onana (Manchester United) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
89' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
87' Casemiro (Manchester United) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
86' Casemiro (Manchester United) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
85' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Nottingham comes to nothing.
85' Substitution. Scott McTominay (Manchester United) in, Antony out.
84' Chris Wood (Nottingham) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A brilliant save by Andre Onana stops the ball from going inside right post.
82' A yellow card for a tackle by Marcus Rashford (Manchester United). Stuart Attwell doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
81' Steven Cooper prepares a substitution. Danilo is replaced by Anthony Elanga (Nottingham).
81' Substitution. Taiwo Awoniyi will be replaced by Chris Wood (Nottingham).
81' Taiwo Awoniyi (Nottingham) plants a header from the edge of the box after a nice cross from the free kick. It lacks accuracy and the ball flies well wide of the left post.
81' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) takes the ball and sets it for the free kick.
78' Lisandro Martinez (Manchester United) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
76' 3 - 2 Goal! Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) puts the ball into the bottom left corner past the outstretched arm of Matt Turner.
76' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) is going to take the penalty!
75' Stuart Attwell blows the whistle, Danilo (Nottingham) is penalised for a foul. That is a penalty kick for Manchester Utd.
74' The referee blows his whistle, Manchester Utd are awarded a corner kick.
74' Corner kick. Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) is ready to send the ball into the box.

74' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Manchester Utd.
73' Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
71' 67:33 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
70' The referee allows time for a substitution. Brennan Johnson will be replaced by Cheikhou Kouyate (Nottingham).
69' A lofted cross from Taiwo Awoniyi (Nottingham) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
67' Joe Worrall (Nottingham) takes out his opponent with a nasty slide tackle and receives a straight red card from the referee!
65' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Joe Worrall (Nottingham).
62' Today's referee Stuart Attwell rightly decides to book Ola Aina (Nottingham) for his harsh tackle.
60' Here is a change. Anthony Martial is going off and Erik ten Hag gives the last tactical orders to Jadon Sancho (Manchester United).
60' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the left post.
58' Aaron Wan-Bissaka (Manchester United) picks up a yellow card.
57' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Moussa Niakhate (Nottingham) comes onto the pitch for Scott McKenna.
56' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
54' Manchester Utd have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
54' A cross from a corner kick by Manchester Utd is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
54' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Manchester Utd.
53' Joe Worrall (Nottingham) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.

52' 2 - 2 Goal! Bruno Fernandes manages to prod the ball to Casemiro (Manchester United) after a melee inside the box, and he needs no second invitation to slot the ball into the bottom left corner. 2:2.
51' Danilo (Nottingham) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
48' A cross from Antony (Manchester United) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Erik ten Hag probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Raphael Varane (Manchester United). He is replaced by Victor Lindelof.
46' Referee Stuart Attwell blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Brennan Johnson (Nottingham) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
45+2' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) argues strongly with the referee and is awarded a yellow card. A needless yellow card!
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Serge Aurier (Nottingham) was quite harsh and Stuart Attwell didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
42' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Manchester Utd was in an offside position.
40' Manchester Utd can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
39' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
37' Manchester Utd seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
35' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
34' Anthony Martial (Manchester United) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross.
33' A pass from Brennan Johnson (Nottingham) is intercepted by Andre Onana and the move breaks down.
30' Flag goes up against Willy Boly (Nottingham) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
28' A clumsy foul by Ola Aina (Nottingham) and Stuart Attwell blows his whistle.
27' Casemiro (Manchester United) blows a golden opportunity from inside the 6-yard box. He pounces on the rebound to head the ball just wide of the left post.
26' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.

26' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. The ball is out of play and Manchester Utd manage to earn a corner.
25' The possession of the ball – 83:17.
22' Christian Eriksen (Manchester United) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
20' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.

17' 1 - 2 Goal! Christian Eriksen (Manchester United) takes a short pass from Marcus Rashford in his stride in the box, jinks inside his man and unleashes an unstoppable shot inside the right post. 1:2.
15' A cross into the box from Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) is cleared.
13' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
11' Taiwo Awoniyi (Nottingham) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
10' Brennan Johnson (Nottingham) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
9' The referee points to the corner flag and Manchester Utd will take a corner.
9' Anthony Martial (Manchester United) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
6' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.

4' 0 - 2 Willy Boly (Nottingham) gets to the ball inside the penalty area and produces a bullet header towards the goal. He aims his effort nicely into the top right corner, leaving Andre Onana helpless. He makes it 0:2.
2' 0 - 1 Taiwo Awoniyi (Nottingham) gets in a good position after an exceptional individual run and releases a powerful shot that flies precisely into the bottom left corner.
2' Manchester Utd force their opponents to concede a corner.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are on the pitch and Manchester Utd will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Stuart Attwell.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
